dz: 大北方战争：强者奥古斯都二世率领的数量上占优势的波兰撒克逊军队，在有利的防御位置作战，在克利索战役中被国王查理十二指挥下的瑞典军队击败，其规模只有其一半。
de: Great Northern War: A numerically superior Polish-Saxon army of Augustus II the Strong, operating from an advantageous defensive position, is defeated by a Swedish army half its size under the command of King Charles XII in the Battle of Klissow.

dz: 把简·格雷夫人安放为英国女王的尝试在仅仅9天后就崩溃了.

de: The Tudor warship Mary Rose sinks off Portsmouth; in 1982 the wreck is salvaged in one of the most complex and expensive projects in the history of maritime archaeology.

de: Arab–Byzantine wars: Battle of Apamea: Fatimids defeat a Byzantine army near Apamea.

de: Battle of Simancas: King Ramiro II of León defeats the Moorish army under Caliph Abd-al-Rahman III near the city of Simancas.

dz: 罗马篡位者莱昂提乌斯被封为塔尔苏斯(现代土耳其)的东方皇帝. 他在安提俄克被承认并成为他的首都.
de: Leontius, Roman usurper, is crowned Eastern emperor at Tarsus (modern Turkey). He is recognized in Antioch and makes it his capital.

te: The Great Fire of Rome causes widespread devastation and rages on for six days, destroying half of the city.
dz: 罗马大火造成了广泛的破坏并持续了6天的愤怒,摧毁了半个城市.
